    About this item

    • DURABLE: Created to last, this aesthetic composition notebook comes in assorted colors and has a durable sewn binding. Composition wide ruled lined paper notebook journal is great for permanent note-taking in class or at home.
    • 5 PACK: This notebook bundle includes 5 books of 100 sheets (200 pages), giving you plenty of space to take notes in school, college or at work.
    • GET ORGANIZED: This composition notebook is perfect for taking notes or any other information that you don't want to forget. These wide ruled composition books are great for school writing or as science notebooks, for assignments and office tasks.
    • WIDERULED SHEETS: Each composition notebook contains 7.5" x 9.75" wide ruled sheets, to help you keep your notes organized. The premium quality paper of these marble composition notebook handles mechanical pencils, gel pens, ink pens and highlighters for perfect notes and won't bleed ink so you have a wonderful experience.
    • SLEEK DESIGN:These composition notebooks are created with a sleek and sturdy multicolor marble design, this composition notebook is both useful and professional in appearance. Primary school and college can use it to write down notes or hand in homework.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    About this Item

    • DURABLE: Created to last, this aesthetic composition notebook comes in assorted colors and has a durable sewn binding. Composition wide ruled lined paper notebook journal is great for permanent note-taking in class or at home.
    • 5 PACK: This notebook bundle includes 5 books of 100 sheets (200 pages), giving you plenty of space to take notes in school, college or at work.
    • GET ORGANIZED: This composition notebook is perfect for taking notes or any other information that you don't want to forget. These wide ruled composition books are great for school writing or as science notebooks, for assignments and office tasks.
    • WIDERULED SHEETS: Each composition notebook contains 7.5" x 9.75" wide ruled sheets, to help you keep your notes organized. The premium quality paper of these marble composition notebook handles mechanical pencils, gel pens, ink pens and highlighters for perfect notes and won't bleed ink so you have a wonderful experience.
    • SLEEK DESIGN:These composition notebooks are created with a sleek and sturdy multicolor marble design, this composition notebook is both useful and professional in appearance. Primary school and college can use it to write down notes or hand in homework.

    Product Description

    Rosmonde Black Marble Composition Books The perfect notebook for school, office, or everyday use! Get organized with this 5 and 12 pack of Rosmonde Composition notebooks. Great for any task, these notebooks provide wide-ruled pages that offer more space than college ruled notebooks. Making them ideal for students as well as writers, artists, scientists, and any type of note taker. Made with a durable cover and sewn binding this notebook can also deal with wear and tear that comes with everyday use. Inside, the paper handles all types of pens, pencils, and highlighters for writing creative and organized notes. Don’t hesitate and add these composition notebooks to your school or office supplies today!
